title: Magento order emails: the stuck queue_message_status row
lede: A Dutch agency calls at 23:41: their Magento store has not sent an order confirmation in three days. The trail leads to one row in queue_message_status.
hero_alt: Overhead photo on bone linen: Magento queue-debug worksheet, SQL notes, UNDELIVERED email printout, manila folder, red wax seal.
